response.original_title: Hyperdimension Neptunia The Animation: Little Purple Sunshine
response.overview: In a world known as Gamindustri, four Goddesses and their sisters use the power of Shares to rule over their respective nations – the Goddess Neptune of Planeptune, Noire of Lastation, Blanc of Lowee, and Vert of Leanbox. As former mortal enemies, what will happen to Neptune and Arfoire living together at an eggplant farm?
